Description: Every interactive element needs a 48x48dp touch area, even when the visible icon is smaller
Do: Use IconButton or Modifier.minimumInteractiveComponentSize()
Don't: Make a 24dp icon clickable on its own

Description: TalkBack reads contentDescription; decorative images must pass null
Do: Give icon-only buttons and informative images a localized description
Don't: Leave icon-only buttons unlabeled or describe decorative images

Guideline: Merge descendants of a list item
Description: A row with text and icons should be read as one item
Do: Make the whole row clickable or merge its semantics
Don't: Let TalkBack stop on every child of a card
Code Bad: Row { Text(title); Icon(...); Text(date) } with separate focus stops

Description: Custom clickable or toggleable elements need the right role so TalkBack announces them
Do: Pass role = Role.Button, Role.Switch or Role.Checkbox
Don't: Use a bare clickable Box as a button or switch
Code Good: Modifier.toggleable(value = on, role = Role.Switch, onValueChange = onToggle)

Guideline: Text sizes in sp that scale
Description: Users enlarge fonts; layouts must survive 200% font scale
Do: Use MaterialTheme.typography and let containers grow
Don't: Fix heights that clip scaled text or use dp for text

Description: Text needs 4.5:1 contrast (3:1 for large text and UI shapes)
Do: Pair surfaces with their on-colors (onSurface, onPrimary)
Don't: Hard-code gray text on colored backgrounds
Code Bad: Text(label, color = Color(0xFF9E9E9E)) on a primary background

Description: Status and errors must also use text, icons or shape
Do: Add an icon or label next to a colored status
Don't: Show validity only with a red or green border

Description: Section titles marked as headings let TalkBack users jump between sections
Do: Add semantics { heading() } to screen and section titles
Don't: Style titles as headings only visually

Description: Keyboard, D-pad and TalkBack follow focus order
Do: Keep a natural order; adjust with traversalIndex or isTraversalGroup only when needed
Don't: Leave focus jumping between columns or unreachable elements
Code Bad: Interactive element that cannot receive focus

Description: Announce selected, expanded or progress states that are only visual
Do: Set stateDescription for custom selectable and expandable items
Don't: Rely on color to show selection
Code Good: Modifier.semantics { stateDescription = if (expanded) expandedLabel else collapsedLabel }
Code Bad: No semantics on an expandable card

Guideline: Verify with TalkBack and Accessibility Scanner
Description: Automated rules miss real reading order and labels
Do: Walk every new screen with TalkBack and run Accessibility Scanner or Compose UI test checks
Don't: Ship without a screen-reader pass
Code Bad: No accessibility assertions in UI tests

Description: Colors, type and shapes come from MaterialTheme so dark mode and branding stay consistent
Do: Read MaterialTheme.colorScheme, typography and shapes
Don't: Hard-code colors and text styles in screens

Description: Every screen must work in dark theme
Do: Provide darkColorScheme and test both themes
Don't: Assume a light background

Guideline: Dynamic color with a brand fallback
Description: Android 12+ can derive colors from the wallpaper
Do: Use dynamicColorScheme on Android 12+ when the brand allows it, with a fixed scheme below
Don't: Crash or lose contrast on older devices

Description: Content draws behind system bars; insets keep it readable and tappable
Do: Call enableEdgeToEdge() and apply Scaffold innerPadding or WindowInsets
Don't: Let content sit under the status or navigation bar

Description: The keyboard must not cover the focused field or the submit button
Do: Use imePadding() or Scaffold insets and scroll the form
Don't: Fixed forms that hide fields behind the keyboard
Code Bad: Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) with fields at the bottom

Description: Phones, foldables and tablets need different navigation and panes
Do: Use window size classes, NavigationSuiteScaffold or list-detail layouts
Don't: Stretch a phone layout to a tablet
Code Bad: One fixed column on every screen width

Guideline: Flexible sizes instead of fixed ones
Description: Fixed widths break on small screens and large fonts
Do: Use weight, fillMaxWidth and wrapContent
Don't: Hard-code widths for text containers

Description: Consistent spacing improves scanning
Do: Use 4dp multiples (8, 12, 16, 24) from shared tokens
Don't: Use arbitrary paddings such as 13dp

Description: Keys keep item state and animations correct when data changes
Do: Pass key = { it.id } to items()
Don't: Rely on position for items that move or are removed

Description: contentType lets Compose reuse compositions efficiently
Do: Set contentType for headers, items and ads
Don't: Mix item kinds without contentType in long lists

Description: Composables re-run often; expensive work must be remembered or moved
Do: Use remember, derivedStateOf and the ViewModel for heavy work
Don't: Sort or format large lists inside the composable body
Code Bad: val sorted = items.sortedBy { it.date } // every recomposition

Description: Images must not block the UI or shift layout
Do: Use Coil AsyncImage with a size, placeholder and error image
Don't: Decode bitmaps on the main thread or leave size unknown
Code Good: AsyncImage(model = url, contentDescription = null, modifier = Modifier.size(64.dp), placeholder = painterResource(R.drawable.ph))

Description: Reading animated state in a lambda modifier avoids recomposing the whole tree
Do: Use Modifier.offset { } or graphicsLayer { } with lambdas
Don't: Read animated values directly in composition

Guideline: Hoist state and use unidirectional data flow
Description: Stateless composables are reusable, previewable and testable
Do: Pass state down and events up; keep screen state in a ViewModel
Don't: Keep business state inside leaf composables

Description: Every asynchronous screen shows what is happening and how to recover
Do: Model UiState with Loading, Empty, Error (with retry) and Content
Don't: Show a blank screen or an endless spinner
Code Good: when (state) { Loading -> Progress(); Empty -> EmptyView(); is Error -> ErrorView(onRetry); is Content -> List(state.items) }

Description: Users tap twice when nothing seems to happen
Do: Disable the button and show progress while the action runs
Don't: Leave the button enabled during a request
Code Good: Button(onClick = onPay, enabled = !state.submitting) { if (state.submitting) CircularProgressIndicator() else Text(payLabel) }

Guideline: Survive configuration changes and process death
Description: Rotation, theme change or process death must not lose user input
Do: Use rememberSaveable for UI state and SavedStateHandle in the ViewModel
Don't: Keep form input only in remember

Description: Short confirmations and undo belong in a Snackbar inside the Scaffold
Do: Use SnackbarHostState with an action such as Undo
Don't: Use Toast for important or actionable messages

Description: Deleting or discarding data needs a confirmation or an undo
Do: Use AlertDialog for irreversible actions and Undo for reversible ones
Don't: Delete immediately without a way back

Guideline: Pull to refresh for refreshable content
Description: Users expect to refresh feeds and lists with a gesture
Do: Wrap refreshable lists in PullToRefreshBox
Don't: Offer refresh only through a menu
Code Bad: No refresh affordance on a live list

Description: Android 14+ previews the back destination; custom back handling must cooperate
Do: Opt in with android:enableOnBackInvokedCallback and use BackHandler or PredictiveBackHandler
Don't: Override back with onBackPressed or block system back

Description: Top-level destinations need a persistent, labeled navigation bar
Do: Use NavigationBar with icons and labels; a rail on larger windows
Don't: Use a hamburger drawer for 3 primary destinations or hide labels
Code Good: NavigationBar { items.forEach { NavigationBarItem(selected, onClick, icon, label = { Text(it.label) }) } }

Guideline: Clear top app bar and up navigation
Description: Users must know where they are and how to go back
Do: Show a title and an up arrow on detail screens
Don't: Detail screens without title or back affordance
Code Good: TopAppBar(title = { Text(title) }, navigationIcon = { IconButton(onUp) { Icon(Icons.AutoMirrored.Filled.ArrowBack, up) } })
Code Bad: Detail screen with no top app bar

Description: Deep links must open the right screen with the right back stack
Do: Declare deep links in the navigation graph and test them
Don't: Untested deep links that open an empty screen
Code Bad: Deep link handled manually in onCreate

Description: Placeholders disappear while typing; labels stay and are read by TalkBack
Do: Use the label parameter and supportingText for hints
Don't: Use placeholder as the only label

Description: The right keyboard and action button speed up input
Do: Set KeyboardOptions(keyboardType, imeAction) and KeyboardActions
Don't: Default text keyboard for email, phone or numbers
Code Bad: No keyboardOptions on an email field

Description: Errors appear next to the field with a clear message
Do: Use isError with supportingText and announce the error
Don't: Show only a generic error dialog after submit
Code Good: OutlinedTextField(..., isError = state.emailError != null, supportingText = { state.emailError?.let { Text(it) } })

Description: Autofill reduces typing for credentials, addresses and cards
Do: Provide content type semantics for autofillable fields
Don't: Block autofill on login and address fields
Code Bad: Custom field that autofill cannot recognise

Description: Transitions explain change; 150-300ms keeps them quick
Do: Use AnimatedVisibility, animate*AsState and Material motion durations
Don't: Long or decorative animations on every interaction

Description: Users who disable animations must not see large motion
Do: Check the animator duration scale and shorten or skip non-essential animations
Don't: Force long animations when animations are off

Guideline: Request permissions in context with a rationale
Description: Ask when the feature needs it and explain why; handle denial
Do: Request at the point of use, show a rationale and a fallback when denied
Don't: Request every permission at launch or loop on denial
Code Bad: Request camera, location and contacts in onCreate

Description: Localized strings, plurals and formatting live in resources
Do: Use stringResource and pluralStringResource
Don't: Hard-code user-facing text in composables

Description: Arabic and Hebrew mirror layouts
Do: Use start and end, AutoMirrored icons and test RTL
Don't: Use left and right paddings or non-mirrored arrows

Guideline: Previews for states, dark theme and font scale
Description: Previews catch layout issues early
Do: Add previews for each UiState with @PreviewLightDark and @PreviewFontScale
Don't: One preview of the happy path only

Description: The system splash screen replaces custom splash activities
Do: Use installSplashScreen() and keep it while initial data loads
Don't: Add a custom splash activity with a fixed delay

Description: Material 3 components include accessibility, states and motion
Do: Use Button, FilledTonalButton, Card, ListItem, ModalBottomSheet
Don't: Rebuild buttons and sheets from Box and clickable

Description: Secondary actions and pickers fit in a modal bottom sheet
Do: Use ModalBottomSheet with a drag handle and dismiss on back
Don't: Navigate to a new screen for a two-option choice
